description: Search active Agent Ops Jobs listings. Featured roles are listed first among the matches. Each result includes a featured boolean. Does not include closed roles.

employment_type.description: contract also matches contract-to-hire and other contract listings. part-time and fractional match listings whose type contains that word.

query.description: Words matched against title, company, location, summary, and tags.

remote.description: True keeps remote roles. False keeps hybrid and on-site roles.
